test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Many a slip between the cup and the lip.

options.text: Bad things may happen before the task is finished
The cup is slippery and likely to break if you are not careful
The work is going as per plan and must be completed
The tea is too hot and likely to burn the lips

solution:
The correct answer is **'Bad things may happen before the task is finished'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom 'Many a slip between the cup and the lip' is 'Bad things may happen before the task is 'finished'.
